question: A hemispherical dome covers a circular area of diameter 20 m. What is the approximate curved surface area of this dome?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius of the dome (r) = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 m

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere = 2 × π × r²

CSA ≈ 2 × 3.14 × (10)²

CSA ≈ 628 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 628 m².**
